description: The note-authority state machine of specs/13 (B040) as five scenarios: an app-owned note published to a vault (create, echo suppression, duplicate operation, republish with the last-seen hash, an external edit kept as a conflict, choose app, unpublish); a vault-owned note (reindex on change, a stale write rejected into a conflict keeping both bodies, merge, write-through, delete); explicit migrations in both directions with preview and backup, cancel, commit and replay; a vault file that disappears (detached, read-only, relinked by reappearance and by hand, converted to app-owned); and a rename that updates the path without making a new note. Each step names the event, and either the effect and the binding after or the error kind that refuses it. Hashes, vault id and paths are fixture values; no note text.

scenarios.name: app-owned note published to a vault

steps.name: publish creates the vault file
the watcher's echo of the publish is suppressed by its id
replaying the publish is a no-op
the reader edits in the app
republish carries the last-seen hash
the published copy is edited in Obsidian: both bodies kept
a republish is not allowed until the conflict is resolved
the reader keeps the app body: it is written over the vault's
the echo of the resolution write is suppressed
unpublish deletes the vault copy
replaying the unpublish is a no-op

scenarios.name: vault-owned note with a stale write

steps.name: a save in the app is refused under vault authority
the file changes in the vault: the app reindexes
a write that last saw the old file is rejected into a conflict
the reader keeps editing the app body during the conflict
the vault changes again during the conflict: both still kept
a merge writes a third body
the echo of the merge is suppressed
a write-through edit with the current hash
an observation under our id but with another body is an external change
deleting the note deletes the file; the app keeps the recoverable body
replaying the delete is a no-op
a second delete with a new id has nothing to delete

scenarios.name: explicit migrations with preview and backup

steps.name: migrating to a vault needs a vault
migrating to the current authority is refused
begin: preview and backup, authority unchanged
the body is frozen during the preview
an external change during the migration is refused
committing another body than the preview is refused
cancel returns to app-owned with nothing written
begin again
commit creates the file and moves authority to the vault
replaying the commit is a no-op
the echo of the commit is suppressed
begin migrating back to the app
commit moves authority to the app and leaves the file
an edit of the file is now a conflict, not an import
the reader takes the vault body
replaying the resolution is a no-op

scenarios.name: vault file gone: detached, relinked, converted

steps.name: the file is gone: detached
a detached note is read-only
a write is refused while detached
still gone
the file reappears moved, same body: the path is updated
gone again
relinked to an edited file: the vault wins
gone a third time
the reader converts the note to app-owned with the app copy
relink is not defined for an app-owned note

scenarios.name: a renamed file is the same note

steps.name: a rename updates the path and nothing else
a write goes to the new path
the echo arrives with the path
a rename to an unsafe path is ignored

source: specs/13-obsidian-and-ink.md, Ownership and scope, Direct vault integration; specs/03-data-model.md, NoteBinding; crates/notes/src/binding.rs
